model.name: stepped-table-per-printed-range
model.of: the byte at a rate address, and the frequency the modulator runs at
model.chosen_by: the range the page prints against that address

what: One printed table per printed range, walked in whole steps and holding its last entry where the table is shorter than the byte.
note: Generated from the candidate this file names, and read only by src/soundings/reproduce.py. It states what the candidate predicts at every setting of the byte, so that a reading can disagree with it. Nothing here is a measurement.

0.05 - 10.0.why_it_ends_early: Three runs of 100, 20 and 6 come to 126 entries, so settings 126 and 127 have no entry of their own and return the last one.
